_readme: Hand-written benchmark. Each question lists the chunk_id(s) considered 'relevant' (gold). Written by inspecting the actual source documents, independent of what any retrieval method currently returns, to reduce bias toward the system's existing behavior.

questions.question: Why did European revenue decline in Q2?
questions.note: Requires both the finance report's summary of causes AND the product doc's specifics on the recall to fully answer.
